We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we don't have SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it likely returns the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it. Then count methyl peaks (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbon signals (~10-30 ppm). But easiest: get proton NMR.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
